title: Trabzon Expedition (1510)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Trabzon Expedition (1510)", at revision 1380596139, opens: "The Trabzon Expedition refers to the event in 1510 when Shah Ismail sent a military force to Trabzon." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q111938762, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1510 military campaign". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
